info.title: TWiT API
info.description:
This is the API documentation for **TWiT.tv**.

These endpoints are read-only (HTTP `GET`) and publish TWiT.tv content to the
website and to other API consumers such as apps.

## Access

These endpoints are open and require no authentication. Send a plain `GET`
request:

```
curl "https://api.twit.tv/api/v1.0/shows"
```

## API conventions

### HAL + JSON
The API returns HAL+JSON with `_embedded` resources to reduce roundtrips,
`_links` for HATEOAS, and properly formatted JSON attributes for semantics.

### API versions
Version and content type are selected through the URL path, e.g.
`/api/v1.0/{resource}`. The current version is 1.0.

### Filtering
+ Most resources can be filtered by their attributes (though not every
  attribute) in the form `filter[attributeName]=value`.
+ Dates are returned in Zulu (UTC) time.
+ Most dates can be filtered using unix timestamp format.

### Sorting
Use the `sort` parameter with the property you wish to sort by. Sorting is
ascending by default; prefix the property with `-` for descending order.
+ `?sort=created` sorts by the `created` property in ascending order.
+ `?sort=-created` sorts by the `created` property in descending order.

### Item endpoints: loadByFieldName
On single-item endpoints you can replace the usual numeric `{id}` with an
alternative value if you also pass `loadByFieldName={fieldName}`, e.g.
`.../shows/tech-news-weekly?loadByFieldName=label`. This does not work for every
field.
